name: Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan's S. P. Jain Institute of Management & Research (SPJIMR)

programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)
programs.feeNote: Fee for Indian participants; includes tuition fee and basic hostel/accommodation. Indicative and subject to revision. Optional Global Fast Track and International Exchange components not included. International participants: INR 33.32 lakh.
programs.intakeNote: Batch 2027-29 PGDM seats for Indian applicants per official eligibility document; additional 36 supernumerary seats for OCI/PIO/children of Indian workers in Gulf/foreign nationals (max 276). Separate PGDM (BM) programme has 120 seats.
programs.placementNote: Combined PGDM + PGDM (BM) Class of 2026: 356 participants, 100% placed; highest CTC INR 75 LPA; 80 companies; 46% PPOs. Official press release dated 12 Dec 2025; no separate PGDM-only figure and no audit reference stated.

selectionProcess.name: Application and profile scoring
selectionProcess.detail: Applicants choose two specialisation preferences. Profiles scored on consistency of academic record (10th, 12th, every year of graduation), relevance of work experience to chosen specialisation, versatility and achievements.

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting for interviews (two phases)
selectionProcess.detail: Phase 1: profile-based shortlist (must still meet minimum CAT/GMAT qualifying score). Phase 2: profile-cum-score shortlist after entrance test results.

selectionProcess.name: Final selection on composite score
selectionProcess.detail: Composite of profile, academic record, entrance test score (CAT/GMAT), relevance of work experience (if any) and performance in the two interview rounds. Weights not published.

keyDates.notes: 2027-29 batch; CAT 2026 or GMAT (taken 1 Jan 2024 - 10 Dec 2026, in-person only). Application fee INR 2,500 (INR 4,000 for PGDM + PGDM (BM) together). Programme starts June 2027. Cutoffs listed are minimum qualifying percentiles.
